institution.name: Hong Bang International University
institution.address: 215 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 15, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
institution.office_hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM

programs.name: B.Tech
programs.specializations: Computer Science, Electronics, Mechanical, Civil, AI & Data Science

eligibility.text: Pass in 10+2 (or equivalent) from a recognized board with minimum 50% aggregate marks. Subject-specific eligibility may apply.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline from a recognized university with minimum 55% aggregate marks.
Master's degree in a relevant discipline with minimum 60% marks. Entrance test and interview required.

apply_steps.title: Fill course and contact details
apply_steps.text: Choose your program level, specialization, nationality and confirm your registered contact information.

apply_steps.title: Fill personal details
apply_steps.text: Provide your name, date of birth, gender, category, address and identification details.

apply_steps.title: Add educational qualifications
apply_steps.text: Add your past qualifications — board, year and percentage / CGPA. You can add multiple records.

apply_steps.title: Fill guardian details
apply_steps.text: Enter parent / guardian information including contact, occupation and emergency details.

apply_steps.title: Upload documents
apply_steps.text: Upload your photograph, mark sheets, ID proof and supporting certificates in PDF / image format.

apply_steps.title: Pay application fee and submit
apply_steps.text: Review your details, complete the application fee payment and submit. You'll get an exam slot once payment is confirmed.
